name: virtx
description: Run tasks in disposable Linux micro-VMs from Python, Node.js or Rust, with a filesystem you compose.

interface.shortDescription: Disposable Linux micro-VMs from your own code
interface.longDescription: virtx runs tasks in disposable Linux micro-VMs from Python, Node.js or Rust, with no Docker and no daemon to install. A console boots a VM from an image you declare, runs commands in it, and is gone when you are done; what the VM sees is a filesystem you compose from host directories, in-memory files and remote stores, mounted read-write or read-only. The GPU reaches into the VM through Vulkan, so heavy work such as deep learning runs there too.
capabilities: Boot a Linux micro-VM from an image recipe, in one builder call
Run commands in it and read their output, from Python, Node.js or Rust
Mount host directories, in-memory files and remote stores into the VM, read-write or read-only
Cut the network, or give the VM a GPU, CPUs and memory
Build images ahead of time and start any number of VMs on them
Fetch the console server with one call; no Docker, no daemon
